speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Mr S Iswaran)
text: The Ministry of Communications and Information’s (MCI's) mission is to connect people to community, the Government and opportunity.

speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Mr S Iswaran)
text: In support of our Smart Nation vision, MCI will grow the digital economy, strengthen Singaporeans’ digital readiness, and secure our cyberspace.

speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Mr S Iswaran)
text: MCI will also enhance Government communications and develop our libraries of the future.

speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Mr S Iswaran)
text: In a future increasingly shaped by digital technologies, Singapore must harness these changes to create opportunities for all.

speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Mr S Iswaran)
text: We will strengthen our media sector so that we can continue producing high-quality and inspiring content.

speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Mr S Iswaran)
text: We will forge ahead with the Design 2025 Masterplan to leverage design as an enabler of innovation and business transformation.

speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Mr S Iswaran)
text: MCI will also launch the Open Innovation Platform to promote innovation and enterprise.

speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Mr S Iswaran)
text: We will launch Digital Leadership programmes to groom the next generation of leaders in digital transformation.

speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Mr S Iswaran)
text: Singapore’s digital economy will be supported by world-class infrastructure and regulations.

speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Mr S Iswaran)
text: We will improve connectivity with the 5th generation (5G) of mobile technology and increase international data flows.

speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Mr S Iswaran)
text: We will do more to help disadvantaged and vulnerable communities, such as seniors and the low-income, use digital technology.

speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Mr S Iswaran)
text: We will look into developing a basic digital access package and setting up touchpoints in the community to provide basic one-on-one assistance on using digital devices and accessing digital services.

speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Mr S Iswaran)
text: We will help Singaporeans build information and media literacy skills so that they are able to discern, evaluate and manage information in an increasingly complex digital environment.

speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Mr S Iswaran)
text: This will also allow Singaporeans to guard against the proliferation of falsehoods.

speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Mr S Iswaran)
text: We will also partner schools to equip students with coding, computational thinking and digital making skills to develop the next generation of future-ready Singaporeans.

speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Mr S Iswaran)
text: We will continue to keep our cyberspace secure, for it is the foundation of a Smart Nation.

speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Mr S Iswaran)
text: Our National Cybersecurity Strategy sets out a comprehensive approach to do so.

speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Mr S Iswaran)
text: We will implement the Strategy to strengthen our critical information infrastructure and develop our cybersecurity ecosystem.

speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Mr S Iswaran)
text: We will also grow our international partnerships, as cyber threats do not respect geographical boundaries.

speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Mr S Iswaran)
text: We will continue to contribute to multilateral efforts to develop cyber norms and work with international partners to drive the development of cybersecurity standards for emerging technologies.

speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Mr S Iswaran)
text: Even as we encourage Singaporeans to embrace digital technologies to improve their lives, we must be on guard against threats and risks that propagate through such technologies.

speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Mr S Iswaran)
text: One such threat is deliberate online falsehoods, which threaten our multiracial society by sowing discord, exploiting fault lines and undermining public institutions.

speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Mr S Iswaran)
text: Apart from building Singaporeans’ info-literacy skills, we will leverage technology to swiftly respond to such threats, including building up the Government’s “Factually” platform.

speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Mr S Iswaran)
text: In light of an increasingly complex communications landscape, we will develop a whole-of-Government Communications Roadmap to transform Government communications capabilities and leverage technology to improve the way the Government engages different age groups and communities.

speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Mr S Iswaran)
text: Public Service Broadcasting will focus on local content reflective of our rich cultural heritage and delivering it through traditional and digital platforms.

speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Mr S Iswaran)
text: We will do more to engage Singaporeans better.

speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Mr S Iswaran)
text: Singaporeans at all levels will have an opportunity to voice their views and suggestions.

speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Mr S Iswaran)
text: We will continue to expand our pool of community, youth and professional partners to widen our outreach to niche communities.

speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Mr S Iswaran)
text: We will also hold Listening Points in new areas to reach out to more segments of the population.

speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Mr S Iswaran)
text: Our libraries are national treasures, providing inclusive social spaces that foster lifelong learning.

speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Mr S Iswaran)
text: We will continue to build our Libraries of the Future and conduct more programmes to make every Singaporean an active library user.

speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Mr S Iswaran)
text: The National Library Board mobile app already brings our libraries to our fingertips; we will continue to digitalise more library services so that they are even more user-friendly.

speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Mr S Iswaran)
text: The National Archives celebrates its 50th anniversary this year.

speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Mr S Iswaran)
text: We will leverage this Golden Jubilee to help Singaporeans uncover gems in our collections and better understand our shared history.

speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Mr S Iswaran)
text: Next year, we also commemorate the Singapore Bicentennial, the 200th anniversary of Sir Stamford Raffles’ landing on Singapore.
